data.title: Air Theremin — play a theremin with motion or bare hands
data.description: Tilt your phone, or wave both hands at the camera: spread them for volume, raise them for pitch. Note snap, cave reverb, oscilloscope and audio recording. Built with the Web Audio API.
data.author: Pavel Gurov
data.keywords: air theremin, theremin, gyroscope theremin, hand tracking theremin, gesture instrument, web theremin, motion theremin, web audio, online synthesizer, browser instrument
